options.opb: Highly specific irreversible and competitive carbonic anhydrase inhibitor.

analysis: Brinzolamide is a carbonic anhydrase inhibitor used primarily to lower intraocular pressure in conditions like glaucoma. It is known to be a reversible and competitive inhibitor of the enzyme carbonic anhydrase. This means it binds to the enzyme in a manner that can be reversed and competes with the natural substrate for binding.
